pages.title: Attunement Liquid
pages.text: A bottle remembers which ore it was brewed from, and that is what the detector is attuned to.$(br2)A millibucket is $(thing)one ore reported$(), the same for every material, so the tank is simply how many finds you are carrying. What differs is what a bottle is worth.$(li)Coal, Copper, Zinc, Tin: 165.$(li)Lapis: 90.$(li)Iron, Gold, Quartz, Amethyst, Uraninite: 45.$(li)Diamond, Emerald: 25.$(li)Ancient Debris: 12.$(br2)Pour one in by holding the bottle in your main hand and the detector in your off hand, then holding right click.
